item.title: Clair Du Vent
item.description: Le clair du vent hurle dans le temps Perdu et promis, il s’étend autour du lit La chair, le sang, perlent en un étang Fourbu et rancis, le bois mort y pourrit Le vil Éole manigance de son éphédrie Le froid retour des lambeaux de terreur Des feuilles chantant dans l’innocente brise Surprises de l’horreur du temps menaçant Ne peut on pas se sécher en douceur Des larmes de peine émises en douleur
item.content:
Le clair du vent hurle dans le temps
Perdu et promis, il s’étend autour du lit
La chair, le sang, perlent en un étang
Fourbu et rancis, le bois mort y pourrit
Le vil Éole manigance de son éphédrie
Le froid retour des lambeaux de terreur
Des feuilles chantant dans l’innocente brise
Surprises de l’horreur du temps menaçant
Ne peut on pas se sécher en douceur
Des larmes de peine émises en douleur
Ne peut-on pas rester près de la chaleur
Dont la sécurité laisse courir les pleurs
Avise jamais de ta noirceur le temps
Qu’il se charge enfin de libérer les fleurs

Lilli

item.title: Retour sur terre
item.description: Une fois rentrée, et l’amer manque passé, une fois secouée et par la vie pressée, je me perds. Il se trouve que j’erre, entre deux mondes, l’un où le coeur se gonfle de joie féconde, et l’autre où les rouages dentés des engrenages civilisés écrasent ma volonté. Dans la spirale, mes souvenirs s’échappent, les chaînes froides me rattrapent. C’est un rêve, et je m’en suis reveillée. Doux, trop court, se termine trop fort trop vite, comme un baiser à peine commencé, la chaleur des lèvres se perdant dans l’espace qui nous a séparé.
item.content:
Une fois rentrée, et l’amer manque passé, une fois secouée et par la vie pressée, je me perds. Il se trouve que j’erre, entre deux mondes, l’un où le coeur se gonfle de joie féconde, et l’autre où les rouages dentés des engrenages civilisés écrasent ma volonté. Dans la spirale, mes souvenirs s’échappent, les chaînes froides me rattrapent.
C’est un rêve, et je m’en suis reveillée. Doux, trop court, se termine trop fort trop vite, comme un baiser à peine commencé, la chaleur des lèvres se perdant dans l’espace qui nous a séparé. C’est une part de gâteau à peine entamée, une infusion des possibles dans la théière déjà froide, et maintenant une tasse vide comme le trou que tu laisses dans ma vie. Comme une bouteille d’ambroisie qu’on a ouvert, on a pu tremper sa langue dans la boisson des dieux, la béatitude et l’ivresse déjà qui nous est retiré, la bouteille refermée, rangée. Et ma bouche qui pourtant ne cesse de saliver, de repenser à la douceur que je croyais inaccessible aux mortels. Qui suis-je pour avoir cette chance ? Recevoir ce qu’on n’aurait même pas osé imaginer, je suis l’enfant qu’on nomme architecte pour avoir construit un petit château de sable. Je suis l’amie à qui on décerne le nobel de la paix pour avoir partagé son pain au chocolat. Je suis une paysanne se voyant offrir le lys suprême en n’ayant pourtant que bêché son champ. C’est une félicité que seuls les rêves peuvent octroyer. Et peut-être est-ce ça, la réponse. Tu es de la même matière que les rêves. Je suis reveillée maintenant, je suis reveillée.
Je continue d’avancer. Le monde ne s’est pas arrêté. Mais un peu de moi reste là-bas, avec toi.

Lilli

item.title: The Pull
item.description: A sight, a smile, a word, The most captivating art, A joke, a gaze, a laugh, An uncertain pinch in the heart. Who, what, how? I want, I need more A touch, a swirl, a step, Individual to unity, An embrace, a warmth, a scent, A hint of eternity. I see the novelty, I will drink the tea A caress, a nap, a trust, The time it takes to feel,
item.content:
A sight, a smile, a word,
The most captivating art,
A joke, a gaze, a laugh,
An uncertain pinch in the heart.

Who, what, how?
I want, I need more

A touch, a swirl, a step,
Individual to unity,
An embrace, a warmth, a scent,
A hint of eternity.

I see the novelty,
I will drink the tea

A caress, a nap, a trust,
The time it takes to feel,
A soft, a long, a given,
The disordered appeal,

I feel the pull, I know the way,
Not to harm, we have to play

A song, a proposal, a reason,
It was a light to be lit,
A dance, a longing, a kiss,
The place where only us fit,

The smile is true, the mystery is whole,
Who are you?

A little, a bit, a few,
I discover and I enjoy,
A load, a lot, a plenty,
The one was not coy

You light a way,
you show your own

A question, a desire, a fire,
Heart hops and maybe stops,
A fence, a dare, a shove,
A sense, a care, a love,

The last step in queue,
The final note rings true,
Have your thoughts been blue,
I think it may be our perks,
Now I only feel the fireworks

Lilli

item.title: Corps-sans
item.description: La poésie ne suffit plus, les mots sont vides ou évidents, je n’ai plus de passion-avec, je n’ai plus de pathie-en-dedans, où suis-je déjà mort? Là où ils résident, la seule réalité, les vivants cachent et oublient, esclaves de leurs pierres, comme je le suis de l’un tangible: le corps assemble-encore, le poids est lourd, et je suis vide en dedans, je l’explique et ne comprend, les mots sont à plat sur le papier,
item.content:
La poésie ne suffit plus,
les mots sont vides ou évidents,
je n’ai plus de passion-avec,
je n’ai plus de pathie-en-dedans,
où suis-je déjà mort?
Là où ils résident,
la seule réalité,
les vivants cachent et oublient,
esclaves de leurs pierres,
comme je le suis
de l’un tangible:
le corps assemble-encore,
le poids est lourd,
et je suis vide en dedans,
je l’explique et ne comprend,
les mots sont à plat sur le papier,
la poésie ne suffit plus,
tout est de chair emprisonné.

Lilli

item.title: I promise
item.description: a declaration or assurance that one will do something or that a particular thing will happen. Oxford Dictionary Honor Before writing became very common, words were used to bind people. “You have my word” is an expression very similar in meaning to a promise. The word “word” here implies that the act of saying a binding word or expression, such as “I will do X” is, in itself, binding.
item.content:
a declaration or assurance that one will do something or that a particular thing will happen. Oxford Dictionary

Honor

Before writing became very common, words were used to bind people. “You have my word” is an expression very similar in meaning to a promise. The word “word” here implies that the act of saying a binding word or expression, such as “I will do X” is, in itself, binding. At this time, what could be called honor would ensures the person would do what he commited to. A person would lack honor when not doing as he said. Honor was important. People needed to rely on something to assert the trustworthiness of someone. The honor status of people would be known and people knew who to trust.

When writing and contract law became commonplace, honor became unnecessary for trust. Now you trust the paper and the pen, and the system. Honor isn’t a thing to protect anymore. (Not that it’s a bad thing) Does modern society has a Honor system? That’s another debate entirely. We still promise things, but the weight is far lower. Is that true? Maybe the internal moral compass has changed. As far as my experience goes, I didn’t live centuries earlier, and I don’t know if people were true to their word more than people are today. My experience of today though, is that most promises people made to me ended unmet. I have the feeling that people do not feel strongly tied by the promise. This leads to a heavy distorsion between what we say and what we think of it.

Social contract

What does “I promise to do X” mean to you? Let’s say, A says that to B, and assume they are friends not negociating a contract, and cunning is not involved: both are of good faith. Does it mean that A has to do X, now that it’s promised? What should B do or think if A doesn’t do X? And what if A tried but didn’t succeed?

I suggest looking at it this way. At the start, A and B didn’t owe anything to each other. You can replace X by “call you tomorrow” or “will visit you next week” or “I won’t be late”. Then, for whatever reason, A promised to do X to B. This now creates a different relation. B is expecting something of A. This expectation can only have negative outcomes: either X is done and that was expected, it’s neutral, either X is not done and B views it negatively. Even for something small, fairly insignificant, ever if B doesn’t really care that X is done, having failed to fulfill a promise changes something. It changes who A is as a person. A is a little bit more a person whose word is not reliable. B is likely to think less of A regarding trustworthiness, and future promises could be met with a raised eyebrow. This process can very well be unconscious, so no amount of “it’s okay, I don’t care” would change it.

I love you darling, I promise I will never leave you

In social context, what do promises mean? What A likely tried to achieve, was to show commitment, or affection toward B. It can show confidence in the ability to do X. It is supposed to leave B to believe “X will be taken care of, you can rest assured”. A having failed to do X, B went from happy to have someone’s help (or anything that X is about), to being disappointed and having to find another way, losing time along the way, or being prepared for X and not having it.

I can see this in social contexts, where promising looks to me like an “affection commitment”. People don’t like uncertainty, so, promising helps alleviate the problem. It’s not “maybe” it’s a promise now! Even if in the end, it’s unmet, at least the previous feeling of uncertainty has been erased (temporarily). It’s a tool to alleviate uncertainty. Especially in insecure couples, where one feels the need to promise to visit every week, or to call or whatever. “I promise I will always love you”. It’s all fun and games until it’s a chore. It is also a way to show that they are ready to put the affection/consideration of the other into play. Indeed, failing to meet the expectations is essentially letting the other have the right to judge you for not giving what is owed, albeit more often than not it’s socially downplayed, but unconsciously important1. Why doing that to oneself? More precisely, why bet on one’s own future feelings? Promising neverending love doesn’t make it happen. (Love should probably be redefined then)

What to do then?

The point is, having promised something is mostly a negative experience. Failing to meet someone’s expectations (when one initially wanted to) is mostly a negative experience. Even if there is no hard binding, a promise is still a promise and will alter the opinion others have of you, but also the one you have of yourself.

A significantly more sensible approach would be to simply not promise anything. If you want to do it, just do it. Or try. Say you’ll try, do your best, that’s all. If the other person can’t deal with that level of uncertainty, then maybe they have some work on themselves to do. A promise is an unnecessary source of stress. For some reason, promises have been romanticized. Also, as hard as it might be, when someone asks you to promise something, refuse. For your own good, do not let people ask things from you. If you want to do it, do it. Truth is, promises are not needed for things to happen.

It’s not much. Don’t put yourself in a position where others expect something from you. (very general (maybe bold) statement, but it’s here in the context of promises. Of course, it can be a tool to play with others’ expectations, and that’s for you to see if you can wield the tool, or if you’ll end up being the social instrument.)

The “proof”

Successfully meeting a promise is rewarding/rewarded. The reward is $R$.
Successfully meeting a promise is difficult and a probability of success can be affected. The probability is $P$.
Unsuccessfully meeting a promise is negatively rewarding/rewarded. The negative reward is $N$.
The Promise is $X$.
The expected reward is $E[X]=RP+N(1-P)$.

Let’s rephrase.
You’re in a casino.
You have a chance $P$ to win the prize.
The prize is $R$.
The entry price in $N$.
The gamble is $X$.
The expected reward is $E[X]=RP+N(1-P)$.

A promise is essentially a social gamble. Is it wrong? Not necessarily. One just needs to remember that not playing is often the way to outsmart the system. Especially when odds are not in your favor. The social reward of the promise is actually quite small, but it exists. A small dose of dopamine, probably. The disappointment being mostly unconsious (but orders of magnitude more impactful) it is downweighted by our short-term idiotic brain.

The reality is that odds are always in your favour when you say “well, I’ll do my best, but I don’t promise it will be done”. Then you have the reward if you succeed. The negative isn’t so bad anymore. The other person isn’t disappointed. Win-Win.

John Doe

  1. I did not prove here that the more or less unconscious effect exists and is important. That’s a hidden (not so hidden anymore) premise. Do you think that it plays a role? How big is it? The disappointment can be very real but since this case is obvious, I don’t talk too much about it. [return]

item.title: Vide
item.description: Parfois je me sens vide. Vide comme un panier à champignons sans champignons. En fait, je sais pas vraiment comment c’est d’être vide comme un panier à champignons sans champignons. Mais je sais ce que c’est, ce vide qui me prend. Comme un vers qui n’a laissé derrière lui qu’une large cavité, là où il y avait mes émotions. Et soudain, plus rien. Le chaud, le froid m’indiffèrent. Le sucré me laisse de marbre.
item.content:
Parfois je me sens vide. Vide comme un panier à champignons sans champignons.
En fait, je sais pas vraiment comment c’est d’être vide comme un panier à champignons sans champignons.
Mais je sais ce que c’est, ce vide qui me prend. Comme un vers qui n’a laissé derrière lui qu’une large cavité, là où il y avait mes émotions.
Et soudain, plus rien. Le chaud, le froid m’indiffèrent. Le sucré me laisse de marbre.
La perspective du pain grillé beurre-salé-confiture me fait soupirer tant l’entreprise semble futile.
Mais ce n’est pas grave, ça arrive. Le chocolat chaud peut bien attendre le temps qu’il faudra.

Mais voilà qu’un message affectueux ne m’arrache plus de sourire.
Que l’idée même d’ami semble lointaine, brumeuse, fastidieuse presque.
Je me demande qu’est-ce que c’est ce que ces gens ressentent. Ça semble étranger.
C’est peut-être ça finalement les émotions. Un corps étranger que mon système immunitaire parvient parfois à repousser.
Mais en plus du sentiment de vide, quand j’ignore cette affection, quand je me rend compte que mon moi est vide d’amour, je me sens comme tomber.
Comme une chute libre qui ne commence jamais vraiment, et qui ne s’achève que lorsque je porte mon attention ailleurs.
Je sais qu’il me manque quelque chose, et ça a l’air important.
Des sentiments d’affection qui durent des centaines, voir des milliers de jours. Et à ce moment, je ne ressent rien.
Des milliers de grains de poussière.

Je ne suis plus ici, je ne suis plus humain.
Je n’éprouve ni plaisir ni malheur. Je sens que j’ai perdu quelque chose.
J’évolue dans un banal espace quadridimensionnel. Mes sens ajoutent quelques dimensions, petites, locales.
Et cet espace est à la fois immense et tout à fait étriqué.
Je viens de l’espace où les couleurs sont aussi des odeurs qui sont aussi le feu dans tes yeux.
Je viens du monde où les sons serrent le ventre, où les sourires arrachent des larmes, où les mots pèsent mille tonnes.
Des dimensions qui m’indiffèrent, bien entendu, je ne perçois que leur projections sur mon espace. Ça me semble inutile. Dénué d’intérêt.

Je ne suis pas humain.
Je suis un automate guidé par le besoin irrépressible de persister dans ma nature. Manger, boire, dormir.
Je mange, je bois. C’est pas l’heure de dormir. Mon corps n’a besoin de rien. Mon cerveau n’a besoin de rien.
Je sais qu’il me manque quelque chose, et je tente de comprendre. Vaguement, sans grand intérêt.
Je n’ai rien d’autre à faire après tout.
Je retrouve de tendres souvenirs qui immanquablement auraient du me plonger en nostalgie.
Pourtant c’est bien un visage de marbre qui les accueillis, mais pire encore, un ennui profond.
Qui sont ces étrangers que je reconnais ? Qui est cet homme qui me ressemble trait pour trait ?
L’entreprise de compréhension touchait à sa fin.
L’ennui gagnait.
Le soleil était sous l’horizon,
le lit était froid, mes poils se hérissaient, je contemplais ce fait avec indifférence.

C’est là qu’au réveil, après que la brume cérébrale s’eût dissipée, je contemplait ma mémoire.
Ais-je imaginé? C’est avec l’horreur la plus interne que des larmes perlent.
Culpabilité, déception, mais surtout terreur, et si ça revenait?
Et si ça arrivait encore ? Et ceux que j’aime ?
Tremblotant, presque fiévreux, les images de leurs visages déçus, blessés, dégoûtés me transpercent, me brûlent.
Accepter mes erreurs, mes défauts, bien doués pour ça.
Mais pendant cette déviance inhumaine, j’aurais pu laisser chacun d’eux pour mort.
Je suis inhumain. On pardonne aux humains, on pardonne aux animaux. Être inhumain, c’est bien pire qu’être un animal féroce.
Cette part de moi, est-ce qu’elle est pardonnable ?
La culpabilité est acide.
Je les aime, je les aime profondément. Et ça crie dans mon coeur quand je m’imagine vide d’amour.
Je tremble. J’ai froid. J’ai peur.
Je redoute le moment où cette antithèse de l’humanité reviendra.

Lilli

item.title: Finally the end
item.description: Please do not read if you are in depression or in an unstable mental state. Try this one instead: a better read — You know, some other people are like me. I’ve met some. We share the same story. You’re down, feeling terrible, worthless, you feel there is no salvation to your pitiful soul and you think, you’re absolutely certain that you should’ve been thrown in a bottomless pit long ago.
item.content:
Please do not read if you are in depression or in an unstable mental state. Try this one instead: a better read

— You know, some other people are like me. I’ve met some. We share the same story. You’re down, feeling terrible, worthless, you feel there is no salvation to your pitiful soul and you think, you’re absolutely certain that you should’ve been thrown in a bottomless pit long ago. This oppressing darkness, strangling your throat, making you think threatening thoughts, desire derelict daydreaming and fear fathomless fantasy. For some it’s a terrible emptiness like a parasite eating all your pleasure, your joy to only let an abysmal void behind. Some of us decide to take action. Some do it very quickly, at the peak of their pain, or out of fear that it becomes greater even. I very well understand the extent to which some people are pushed by their sick mind, and they have all my compassion.
Though to me it is… inelegant. Rough. It’s a once in a lifetime craft, I think it deserves at least some sort of planning. Some prefer it flashy, some prefer it quick, some prefer it painful, but most prefer it slow and progressive. As for me, well, I decided it must be absolutely unspectacular. Something that evokes no pain and leaves no lasting scar in the heart of the others. I have the chance to have received a scientific education, and biology, chemistry and physics can help me to rest assured, I’m not afraid to fail or suffer. Though, I know some may weep and I suppose it is a price to pay.
I thought about a location and a mean devoid of any symbol. Nothing should give any hint, any idea about what was wrong. It’s happening, because that’s how things are. Unfair. After carefully designing my moment, I thought I would just carry out the plan. But I just had to leave a message.

— And you want me to be the messenger?

— Maybe you can carry this one instead.
Deciding on a date seemed unnecessary since I wanted to carry it out immediatly. But in the meanwhile, I still had to prepare, and for this, I had to carry on for a while. I surprised myself checking briefly left and right before crossing on my way to work. It took me by surprise, I thought that it may be temporary, a simple effect of the excitement the planning had on me. The reality was that I didn’t want anything else than the planned way. And this very fact made me care. It made me care about my body, my health, what’s left of my morality and principles. The only way to start caring was to prepare the ultimate mean to not care. Nothing should stand before me and the promised release. Health issues are a distraction. It gives meaning and reasons for someone to go. I don’t want this to meddle with it. I am almost smiling you know. Knowing it’s all there, ready to fire at any time. This very fact made me stonger somehow. It made me face situations in front of which past me would have given up. I don’t feel unbreakable but I feel protected.
I know that whatever happens, the perfect exit door is open.
I don’t feel trapped in my life anymore.
I feel free to choose.
I feel free to go on.

Lilli

Explanation

Depression, mental illnesses, tough topic. Tough things happen to everyone and somehow, some can’t figure out how to deal with it. So they break. As human beings, they break. Their mind starts acting up and distorting everything around them. This in turns makes them have irrational, twisted views of themselves, situations, the world. They are not stupid, they are dealing with a great foe.

sow_ay is a great artist making very interesting art about mental illness, mostly depression. I hope you don’t relate to it ;) It was really great to have these drawings. It somehow makes you feel less alone.

So this is an attempt at showing how convoluted, how weird and stupid these illnesses are. The situation can be anything really here. Who’s that messenger? Haaa… Could be me, could be a psychologist. Could be you. Who knows. Anyone who carries a message is a messenger.
What do you carry?

The title refers to both the first and the second part, I like that.
I also had fun with the weird sentence full of alliterations. Not particularly pretty or nice sounding, but fun nonetheless.

The warning is, I suppose, perfectly useless, but it’s (possibly) important to state that this is unlike other poems about how great life can be. But hey, that’s how things are.

So I’m happy I had these thoughts out of my head for now. They come and go. Could think you’d get used to deal with those, but heh, somehow they always seem to get back to you.

item.title: Cette fille
item.description: J’ai cette fille dans ma tête. J’ai chaud, je transpire. Mon souffle ralenti et la brise fait osciller doucement ma tunique. L’air dans mes poumons est aussi chaud que celui que j’expire. J’écoute les instructions. Je lui prends les mains, doucement, de sorte que la position naturelle des doigts nous tiennent liés. J’entends le son des anges, le son des merveilles et des songes. La harpe m’a presque fait sursauter de joie.
item.content:
J’ai cette fille dans ma tête.

J’ai chaud, je transpire. Mon souffle ralenti et la brise fait osciller doucement ma tunique.
L’air dans mes poumons est aussi chaud que celui que j’expire. J’écoute les instructions. Je lui prends les mains, doucement, de sorte que la position naturelle des doigts nous tiennent liés. J’entends le son des anges, le son des merveilles et des songes. La harpe m’a presque fait sursauter de joie.
Et je commence à bouger, lentement. Gauche. Doucement. Droite. Doucement.
Je sens la tension qui évolue dans mes mains. Mes yeux se ferment avec pour dernière image, nos mains enlacées.
Mes bras sont lourds de chaleur mais mes poils se dressent.
Nous sommes enfin accordés.
Gauche. Droite.
Lentement.
Plus. Lentement.
Sans même ouvrir les yeux, nous plaçons nos mains comme pour une valse.
Nos mains sont moites, nos dos sont humides, la température n’est pourtant plus qu’un vague détail.
Nous sentons notre chaleur se diffuser l’un dans l’autre.
Gauche. Droite.
Même la senteur des corps se déplace au gré du mouvement.
Nous ne savons plus qui nous sommes.
L’individualité n’a plus de sens.
Il n’y a que le son de la harpe, une chaleur unique, un mouvement unique.
L’espace qui séparait les corps n’existent plus.
Nous portons les même jambes qui poussent sur le sol, les même bras qui seulement s’effleurent sans que rien ne puisse les séparer, les même seins qui se collent sur la poitrine, le même poids qui se déplace lentement de gauche à droite. Un souffle lent et chaud vient faire évaporer la sueur sur nos épaules. Le mouvement se fait plus lent, mais la connexion se fait plus forte encore. L’immobilité au rythme des cordes, le silence du mouvement oscillant qui se propage sans que rien ne bouge.
Sauf que tout bouge à l’intérieur.
Le plus subtil des mouvements est un tsunami de sensations. On attend le prochain battement de coeur avec impatience, la célébration de la vie, l’hymne de l’être unique.
La sensation d’une tendre caresse sur le dos est une extase qui pleure sans voix.
Le souffle chaud sur les corps nous soûle et nous asservi à l’addiction. Et maintenant c’est notre identité qui se consume. D’un feu doux, d’un feu qui étreint, d’un feu qui rassure.
Un sentiment simple, celui d’être assez, celui d’être là où il le faut.

Doucement le mouvement s’estompe, les voix arrivent, il est temps. La transe se rompt comme un elastique qui claque entre les doigts.
Mes yeux sont éblouis, mais je distingue une expression dont la neutralité ne fait que refléter la mienne.
Perdu, dans le monde réel, sans harpe ni certitudes, je m’accroche à son cou, lentement, sans même me rendre compte qu’elle esquisse le même geste. La senteur rassurante de celle avec qui j’avais entamé l’exercice m’apaise.
Et là, un moment, nous partageons à deux le retour au réel. Une tristesse m’envahit, le chagrin d’avoir quitté l’extase, soutenable seulement par la joie, plus immense encore, de l’avoir connue. Je la regarde avec le sentiment, pendant un moment, de la plus grande vulnérabilité. Je suis là, devant toi, et tu as touché l’essence de mon âme. Je te sens fébrile aussi. Un simple merci chanté de concert par nos voix comme brisées par mille ans de silence.
On se déplace, on parle à nouveau, on rejoint le groupe, encore un peu sonnés. Et le coeur comme secoué, la vie se poursuit. Dans quelques minutes ce sera passé. Tout ça devient “c’était bien”. On ne se souvient plus des instructions, vaguement de la harpe. Peut-être que je fabule, que ce n’était qu’un rêve, après tout, une telle extase est étrange, invraisemblable. Les souvenirs, c’est précieux, c’est une part de nous. Comme le sable ils se faufilent et on n’en garde que quelques grains. Comme un rêve, ils s’échappent de nos pensées aussi vite qu’ils le peuvent. On sait que nos expériences nous façonnent en tant qu’humains, nous font grandir. Tu penses qu’en retrouvant des souvenirs, enfouis, oubliés, des photos, des textes, on puisse grandir encore? Finalement si on l’a oublié, peut-être qu’on peut regarder notre souvenir avec nos yeux nouveaux. Peut-être qu’on peut grandir encore, rien qu’avec ce qu’on a.

Lilli

Explications

Gennetines. J’étais à Gennetines, voilà.

Bon, j’étais donc au grand bal de l’Europe, à Gennetines, et j’ai rencontré M, qui m’a bien fait marré, on a bien dansé ensemble. Et puis au final on se retrouvait tous les jours, que ce soit pour manger ou danser ou certains ateliers. Et puis vint la “Relaxation valsée”. Et c’était ça. C’était la relaxation valsée. Je n’ai aucun doute sur le fait qu’on a pas du tout suivi l’exercice, on s’est juste absorbé l’un l’autre. En même temps y’avait une harpe, ils ont cherché.

J’ai beaucoup apprécié mon temps passé avec elle et sa famille. Je ne sais pas comment ça s’appelle, pas un coup de foudre mais une belle complicité très vite. Dans tous les cas, super expérience, elle a clairement apporté une grosse grosse pierre à l’édifice Gennetines dans ma vie.

La mémoire étant ce qu’elle est, mes souvenirs s’apauvrissent. Mais si je me souviens encore de son rire adorable et de son sourire enjoué, je me souviens encore plus de ce moment partagé. J’espère la revoir à Gennetines à nouveau. Enfin, si Gennetines il y a…

https://www.gennetines.org/en/

item.title: Growth
item.description: Seed When we see a model in life, we generally tend to try, more or less consciously, to become more like it. Because we see something in this person that inspires us, or that feels so right, that we just want to take even just a piece of that for ourselves. Be it a value, a point of view, a character trait, many things can trigger this phenomenon. Is it his unbreakable determination?
item.content:
Seed

When we see a model in life, we generally tend to try, more or less consciously, to become more like it. Because we see something in this person that inspires us, or that feels so right, that we just want to take even just a piece of that for ourselves. Be it a value, a point of view, a character trait, many things can trigger this phenomenon.
Is it his unbreakable determination? The spark of wisdom is her eyes? His infinite kindness? Her unrelenting passion?

Sprout

Whatever might it be, there is something we want to take home, with us, within our very souls. Something that is so gorgeous that we feel our lack thereof. It’s not a feeling of inferiority, it’s not a feeling of not being enough.
It’s the realization that we could be more. That what this person has, that we don’t, would make us a better person. And this fragment of humility, recognizing that someone has something we don’t, it’s what will make us grow. Letting go of this ego that brings us down. Accepting the world the way it is, accepting who we are, and deciding to do something about it.

Flower

Ages after, after relentlessly finding new incredible people, after absorbing all their kindness and wisdom, all of their beautiful passion and determination, you end up struggling, with fewer and fewer bits of humanity left to gather. And at some point, confused and scared, you end up to the wall. Now it’s for you to become even better, to grow even more, radiating the beauty of a thousand friends, the wisdom of a thousand strangers, it’s your turn to create. It’s for you to continue to nurture these qualities, to find a way to be kinder even than the kindest person, to have more wisdom than even the oldest sage, and for your smile to warm a million hearts.

Pollination

When you contemplate this apparently insurmountable mountain, you are left confused, you are left clueless, wandering through the abyss of uncertainty. Of course, you learned to deal with it. Yet there is still concern to be had. The ominous feeling of forgetting something important.
You see the eyes of your young friend, watching you.
He’s looking at you with the same eyes you had when you started your adventure.

Now you know what to do.





John Doe

item.title: Winter feeling
item.description: Introduction: It’s cold outside. Your nose is hardened by the cold and it starts running. Your fingertips are numb and your gloves don’t keep the warmth enough. Your breath creates wonderful volutes that your eyes, squinting through the wind, sometimes contemplate. And you find in your pockets, the cold metal that would deliver you. Your fingers have trouble holding it straight and turning it, but it clicks, it opens, and here you are.
item.content:
Introduction:

It’s cold outside. Your nose is hardened by the cold and it starts running. Your fingertips are numb and your gloves don’t keep the warmth enough. Your breath creates wonderful volutes that your eyes, squinting through the wind, sometimes contemplate. And you find in your pockets, the cold metal that would deliver you. Your fingers have trouble holding it straight and turning it, but it clicks, it opens, and here you are.
I turn a page.

Home:

I want to go home you said. And here you are, pushing the door. I hear these familiar footsteps, this familiar breathing. The noise of the coat hanger, the shoes placed near mine.

The wood in the fireplace crackles.

A warm atmosphere envelops you now. It’s still cold in here, but there’s another kind of warm. The hot chocolate is next to my tea, waiting for you. As I put down my book, I smile looking at your red nose while you take the plaid placed close to the fire. All wrapped up, I hug you on the couch, all the while adjusting the plaid on your shoulders. Your rub you hands together to warm them up, and then wrap them around the cup of hot chocolate.
I take my book and continue where I left off.

The fireplace moans again.

As you are warming up, you put your head on my shoulder, your hair tickling my neck. And with the eyes closed, you feel your body going from numb to resting. Your breathing is calming rapidly. The soft movement of my head while reading, my inaudible breathing, the smell of chocolate. Your adventurous hand caresses my arm, but the cold reality makes it flee back under the plaid. A tender smile rewards your efforts, while your sigh.
I turn a page.
You smile smelling my scent on my neck and place there a kiss before taking a sip of chocolate. A long breath. Yellow orange and red were disputing the space on the walls. You gazed around with this calm and posed look, with the eyes half closed, full of appreciation.

The fireplace sings.

You place your head on my lap. You feel like you belong. You feel like this is where you want to be.
I turn a page.
As your consciousness sinks more and more, you feel a gentle hand stroking your hair, pushing you further into bliss.

Just before letting yourself leave the realm of consciousness you think:

I am home.

Context:

Note: The characters do not have any specified sex or gender. I did not include any gender-related cue. Please imagine whoever you want. (by the way, the hot chocolate is homemade so you can also make it suit your taste… with a dash of cinnamon?)

I really like this kind of atmosphere, calm, quiet, tender, accepting. You may have noticed that no words were exchanged. The idea sprouted from a friend with whom I cuddle a fair bit saying I want to go home and lie down for a bit. For some reason, it resonated and then I wanted to be this person reading a book, I wanted to be this kind, comforting presence.

Comments:

I wanted to show the characters know each other so well that they simply know what is happening in the head of their companion. Just by the breathing, the way the footsteps resonate on the floor, the myriad of infinitely subtle clues and cues, they know perfectly how the other feels. Communication happens, but no words.

I had the idea of placing the fireplace as something exterior, that is simply here and simply happens. The gradation in the presence of the fireplace goes along with the state of the arriving companion: cold and numb, warming up and calming down, comfy and resting. I wanted a contrast with the static character, they’re not doing much, their state doesn’t change but everything would be so different without them.

Turning the pages was an idea in combination with the fireplace to slow down the pace. Read slowly, calmly and let the atmosphere sink into you, that was the idea anyway. The funny thing is, when I wrote it, I was imagining myself as the arriving companion character, and imagining how I felt, tired, cold, numb, how I would’ve reacted, and finally how I would’ve described it from someone else’s point of view. This is why it’s written “you feel x”. I get that it’s disturbing though. Actually, I almost fell asleep.

Stay warm!

item.title: Supernovae
item.description: Encore un débat, je sens déjà que ça pétille en moi. Ça gronde à chaque virgule, ça détonne à chaque point. Je navigue dans cette logique, ces prémisses délicates, ces hypothèses fertiles. Le flot de mes pensées vire gré des implications. Les écueils sauront s’occuper des sophismes jetés par dessus bord, et chaque biais mis à jour se verra mourir au soleil. Au dessus de moi, c’est un feu d’artifice qui jaillit à chaque inférence.
item.content:
Encore un débat, je sens déjà que ça pétille en moi. Ça gronde à chaque virgule, ça détonne à chaque point. Je navigue dans cette logique, ces prémisses délicates, ces hypothèses fertiles. Le flot de mes pensées vire gré des implications. Les écueils sauront s’occuper des sophismes jetés par dessus bord, et chaque biais mis à jour se verra mourir au soleil. Au dessus de moi, c’est un feu d’artifice qui jaillit à chaque inférence. Des images sublimes, ces fracas délicieux se muant en musique dont je ne rate rien. Pas un murmure, pas une couleur, pas une étincelle je ne saurais manquer. Ces textures, ces mouvances, ces tessitures, ces concordances, le ravissement exaltant de la quête de vérité.

 Voir le monde tel qu’il est et non tel que je l’imagine, c’est une fixation, une obsession. Aussi plat que soit mon miroir l’information est distordue. Comment inverser la fonction des perceptions pour retrouver le pur état de la réalité ? La logique, les mathématiques mes outils d’artisan, mes outils de raison. Je taille les démonstrations pour n’en garder que le coeur brillant. Je façonne de solides colonnes qui soutiennent le poids des théorèmes. Je mets au jour les pépites du vrai enfouies dans la terre des superstitions.
 Qui dit vrai, qui dit faux, voilà de bien insipides questions. Ce qui est vrai et ce qui est faux, voilà ce qui compte. Ainsi l’être que je suis se doit de devenir l’outil adapté. Ma personne n’importe que dans son action, pas dans son identité. Ainsi, j’ai du me changer, moi, et me tuer plusieurs fois. J’ai tué tous mes professeurs pour tout apprendre à nouveau. La quête de vérité a fait de moi un meurtrier. Ravageant impunément les vallées de la physique, les marécages des conventions sociales et les abysses de la démagogie. Découvrir et redécouvrir pour que tout soit en moi, je fus maintes fois feuille blanche et maintes fois noirci. Tel le mathématicien se refusant d’accepter une preuve d’une absolue magnificence tant que chaque lemme ne sera pas énoncé clairement. Et c’est bien en peine, car le raccourci est tentant, il n’y a qu’à fermer les yeux, ou même parfois qu’un, il peut suffire d’une moue. Et une foi malicieuse s’insinue, s’installe, et à chaque mégarde elle grignote de la place. Et toi, que fais tu là, à me hérisser les poils ? Mes yeux sont grands ouverts, mon effroi n’égale que ma fascination.

 Qu’est-ce que ce regard qui semble moquer mes feux d’artifice ? D’où vient cette désinvolte manière ? Un éclat familier teinte tes yeux, mes pores frémissent à nouveau. Qui es-tu ? C’est alors que tu te mets à parler ! Quelles belles envolées, quel rythme effréné ! Quel art, quelle réthorique ! Mais affublé de mes gants axiomatiques, ma réponse est bien plus un test qu’une simple réplique. Je construis un échafaudage dogmatique sous un draps de logique. Quelques vis piégeuses mais triviales, quelques poutres épaisses mais creuses. Ma curiosité me faisait vibrer tout entier. Explose pour moi, montre ce que tu as en toi !
J’attendais quelques bruits, quelques couleurs, j’attendais une belle lueur. Ce ne fut pas de cette ampleur.

 De simples mots, honnêtes, sincères, emplis d’une bienveillance de laquelle émergeait une certaine douceur. La confusion suivit. Quel est ce sentiment qui grandit en moi? Que m’avez vous fait, suis-je envoûté? Pas un bruissement, pas un éclat ? Le calme plat.
Les paroles tournèrent une fois de plus dans ma tête. Quelques étincelles apparaissaient. Quelques crépitements. La brise tiédissait. Mais le ciel au dessus de moi avait changé. Je frissonnais.
Enfin je comprenais. Jamais les artifices des Hommes ne m’avaient offert ces couleurs. Les étoiles explosaient. Les unes après les autres, battant la mesure de leur dernier souffle. Elles composaient pour moi l’ode à la vraisemblance, la sonate de la clarté, l’hymne du raisonnement, la symphonie du vrai et du faux. Les notes s’enchaînaient, disloquaient mes questions, anéantissaient mes assertions.
 Contemplant les ruines de mes exercices, je découvrais sous le cadavre fûmant de fausses prémisses enroulé du drapé blanc, un petit oeil dans lequel se reflétait la peinture funeste et magnifique du ciel.

Des yeux. Des milliers d’yeux semblaient me scruter du fin fond de la voie lactée. Comme autant de miroirs pointés sur moi, j’y voyais reflété l’essence de qui j’étais. Mes réflexions fusaient, des noeuds se défirent, des angles s’éclaircirent, des incohérences tombaient, .

Joignant les étoiles, je mourais encore dans la plus pure extase.

Lilli

Image de M57 (nébuleuse planétaire) et d’un champ d’étoiles dont je n’ai pas le nom, les crédits vont à ESA/Hubble, enfin, je sais pas comment faire ça mais en gros c’est expliqué là https://hubblesite.org/copyright

item.content:
Intro

Hearth designates the floor of the fireplace. Try to fill your heart with melancholy to appreciate this poem

Celcius

You know, they say it's warm.
And they say it warms your heart.
And even that some people smile.
But... My thermometer is broken. How can I find out ?

I tried to remember the warmth of the sun,
I think I caught sunburns.
I tried to remember the warmth of the hearth,
My eyes were lost in the ashes.

But nothing makes sense.

Because when I think about it,
And I find my tears flowing,
I know there is more.

You, who knows everything,
Could you tell me
The temperature of a hug ?

Lilli

Context

This poem was made during a fairly dark period of my life. A permanent struggle at the time. I was terribly lacking human contact, be it social or physical (hugs are drugs). I was sick, my mind was barely working. I wanted to share my confusion about how trivial things can become complicated.

Comments

I like the idea of showing that the things we take for granted, can be much deeper than at first sight. And for this, what’s best than a fresh look on life: children. They look at everything, including their emotions, with the eye of discovery. And from time to time, they point something that we overlooked or had long forgotten.
I think that “temperature of a hug” is a beautiful image, and it love it. It’s saddening that I left the poem this way, it could have been so much more.
Oh by the way here is my inspiration:

It is from a mobile music game I love tremendously: Deemo. It made me discover the artist: V.K. (and Mili is fantastic as well) The song is indeed called 擁抱的溫度, or Temperature of a hug if, like me, you don’t read Chinese.

item.content:
Introduction

I always had a keen interest into fractals, I played quite a fair bit with Apophysis. That’s how I created these images:

As you can see, there was also transparency. They look very different on a white or on a black background, you can try (for the first two ones)

Fractals give me a sentiment of infinite complexity, and complexity looks mesmerizing to me. Especially structured complexity, like see how in the Grand-Julian there is usage of symmetry, and also patterns like these circles waving around the red part? Also the symmetry is only an illusion, because looking carefully, the global idea is the same on both side but it’s variating, always redefining itself. I like that, I just can’t help it. It’s so abstract, so deep, but at the same time it’s just a big fat math equation, tailored by myself to unravel its fierce elegance under the form of an image. takes a deep breath

So it was really nice, but I had no idea how to render fractals. And I didn’t care.

Now the time has come. I’ve already written my own (crappy) pathtracer so it cannot be so hard. I understand how raytracing works. But I never had the chance to learn about ray marching.

So I fiddled with python and found some ressources on internet (where else ?) I wanted to have as few info as possible, and I wanted to solve all the problems myself.

Full program in 16 lines

Guess what? It’s easy. I’m not joking:

#this is the object list
o=list()
o.append(Sphere(c=[0.5,0.2,0.2]))
o.append(Sphere([2,2,-5],c=[0.1,0.4,0.7]))
#setting camera parameters, first position, then point to look at
c=Camera([0,1,-15],[0,0,0],fovy=40,xres=300,yres=300)
img=np.zeros([xres,yres,3]) # 3channels
for i in range(0,xres):
    for j in range(0,yres):
        dir=c.getDirPix(i,j)
        cpos=c.pos
        #index, final pos of the ray
        io,sp=rayMarch(cpos,dir,o)
        contrib=[0]*3
        if io==-1:
            contrib=np.array([0]*3)
        else:
            contrib=o[io].c(cpos,dir)
        img[i,j]=contrib

Of course there are the rayMarch() function and the Camera.

Parallel with ray tracing and further explanations

Basically only two things differ from normal ray tracing:

  • intersection function does not really exist anymore
  • objects are represented by a signed distance function
  • your ray is litterally taking small steps to go traverse the scene

The process goes this way:

  • define objects (like spheres) with SDF corresponding to their parameters (radius, position, color)
  • choose an origin $O_r$ for your ray (like, not too far not too close)
  • choose a direction $d$ for your ray (straight on a sphere is good)

Here, Rey Marching begins

  1. then compute the $SDF(O_r)$ for all objects in your scene
  2. take the minimum of it, let’s call it Oscar $msdf$
  3. advance your ray of $msdf$ in the direction d (so it is $newO_r=O_r+msdf$)
  4. then you repeat using the $newO_r$
  5. check if the sdf is EPSILON or less, if it’s the case then you intersected, report the color value
    • EPSILON is here for some more tolerance (floating point errors or stuff can happen)

If you do that, you will loop indefinetely so best thing is to impose a hard limit to the distance the ray can travel Another solution would be to compute the bouding box of the scene (if at all, possible) and to measure the distance from the ray to the farthest point of it. But well, I just use 50, it’s a good number.

You can also impose a number of maximum steps, and if the ray is misbehaving, (doing too many small steps) hop, background color

Ray Marching algorithm

EPSILON=1e-8
LIM=256
END=50
def rayMarch(sp,sd,o:list()):
    ''' sp is starting point, sd is starting direction and o is the list of shapes
    marches in the scene, returns
    * index of Shape intersected
    * last position of ray
    '''
    minlist=[obj.d(sp) for obj in o]
    v=min(minlist)
    index=minlist.index(v)
    depth=v
    i=0
    #test against epsilon here and LIM because sometimes it just gets stuck
    while v>EPSILON and i<LIM:
        minlist=[obj.d(sp) for obj in o]
        v=min(minlist)
        index=minlist.index(v)
        
        sp=sp+v*sd
        i+=1
        # yes I know i compute twice the same stuff,
        # I added this later and I was too lazy to change the rest 
        depth+=v
        if depth>END:
            return -1,sp
    if i>=LIM:
        return -1,sp
    return index,sp

Now, you say, that does not make an image! Of course we need a camera. But that’s maths and all, so let me just say that you give the camera a position to be, a position to look at, and boom, you’re set.

Now that we have a camera, we call the very convenient function getPixelDir(i,j) that gives us the direction or the ray

Let’s say we want a 1080p image, our image is $w=1920$ pixels wide and $h=1080$ pixels high

  • loop $w$ times:
    • loop $h$ times:
    • $d=getPixelDir(i,j)$ ($i$,$j$ are the current loop number for $w$ and $h$ loops)
    • $p=getCameraPos$
    • $color=rayMarch(p,d)$
    • $img[i,j]=color$

Results

boom done. Do that and, like me, you obtain THIS:

Incredible huh?

Yes, it’s shit, but what did you expect? there is no lighting, no bounce of the light. All this is for a real renderer.

okay, let me add the cos term so that it looks like actual balls at least:

I just wanted to see how it works but now, I need to get on the fractal train.

And I have to say, python sucks! It’s so damn slow!

item.title: My Tiny Dragon
item.description: Text I have a dragon in my room. One may ask “Show me your dragon” but I cannot. Sadly, it is small, very very small. And it is fast, very very fast. One may ask “Then how do you know it exists ?” Well it’s simple. Sometimes I feel like I tripped over something but no cable, no furniture just a perfectly flat floor, as if it just carelessly bumped into me.
item.content:
Text

I have a dragon in my room. One may ask “Show me your dragon” but I cannot. Sadly, it is small, very very small. And it is fast, very very fast. One may ask “Then how do you know it exists ?” Well it’s simple. Sometimes I feel like I tripped over something but no cable, no furniture just a perfectly flat floor, as if it just carelessly bumped into me. I regularly sense a peculiar yet very faint smell, like something caught fire. Though after inspection, nothing burnt, no cooking, no worn out cable or electronic device going crazy. It can only be the fiery breath of the dragon, probably roasting its meal. I have no idea about what this dragon eats though. Maybe it picks something from the trash ? Or maybe it steals from the fridge ? I never noticed such a thing, but I suppose such a tiny dragon doesn’t need much. A fly or two from time to time may very well be enough for all I know… One may say “Oh but that’s nothing, you’re probably imagining stuff”. I can only tell you what I experience, but I cannot make you experience my feelings. Let me tell you more about the dragon.

When the wind chimes through my shutters and the sky covers itself of its starry blanket as my consciousness fades, I can hear it, I can feel it. Just next to my head, a calm breathing, a warm breeze. As soon as I try to gather my still sleeping thoughts, it vanishes. I try to place my hand where I felt it but the mattress isn’t warmer, the air isn’t agitated, it simply disappeared. But it was here. Once I was sick and I had terrible stomach pain. Going to sleep was awful, I couldn’t get rest because of the pain, but couldn’t stay awake because I was exhausted. When the clouds made everything dark and the wind howled its best to free the stars, I lost myself to exhaustion. A soft warmth pressing against my belly, just like a hot stone, perfectly adjusted. The hard scales heated up by the ardent inner fire of the dragon made for a very regenerating sleep. The sun just began to rise when I noticed that I slept on the back. I never sleep on the back. I thought it was because of the stomach pain, maybe this position helps. But after testing, the pain is actually more intense when my body is on the back because the whole belly is extended compared to foetal position. I can only think it was to allow the dragon to heal me somehow. My stomach pain was significantly better this day, and although I was not cured, my state was now tolerable.

I do not need you to believe in my dragon, my dragon is very real for me and I like him very much. I believe he is my friend and in any case I will always welcome him and his friends. But I do not care if someone does not believe in my dragon. You might be a scientist thirsty for knowledge, or a psychologist looking for an interesting case. Maybe you want to capture my dragon and study him, or make me sit and interrogate me. Maybe you just want to prove me I’m wrong, that my dragon is nothing but delusions of an imaginative mind. Maybe. But I won’t let you kill my dragon.

You are not allowed any experiment. You are not allowed to make me understand what I actually tripped over or that the sound I heard was something else entirely. You are not allowed to make me doubt that the warmth I felt wasn’t his. My dragon will live on until he decides to leave.

Lilli

Manifest:

The picture is from me, during a trip in Belle-Île. One of my first pictures of the stars. My Fuji X100S is not made for that. I added it when doing the post, more to see how to put images and figure out a way to put them online easily.

Context:

When I wrote this poem I was still active on a forum and there, I exchanged with people persuaded by astrology, by Christianity, by a lot of beliefs that sometimes hurt them more than they help. Some of them were very depressed or even suicidal.

I wanted to share a part of my understanding of this situation.

I find it sad that they have recourse to supernatural explanations and beliefs to feel better. It’s good to have stories, because humans are fueled by stories, but at the same time, they’re not reality. Some really do feel better, some people find in these beliefs something that society does not offer. Psychiatrists fail them, their job fails them, the individualistic capitalist society fails them. And that is not their fault.

And I am delighted that they find something that works for them. That gives some relief.

Yet they start to build a sentimental, emotional bond with it. And as a little girl will outgrow her enthusiastic imagination, they should also outgrow their beliefs. Not in the sense that they should part with them, in the sense that it is not needed anymore. In the state I saw a lot of people in, they were imprisoned by their beliefs. They could not evolve enough to be able to choose if they wanted to live with or without, even when well past the point where these beliefs hurt them more than they help.

This is a topic (“outgrowing beliefs”) that I am fairly sensitive to. I think I have a lot to think about.

Comments:

I like the way it sounds childish.

Confirmation bias: Looking for proofs that aren’t really there, ignoring all the clues that point in other directions The stone moment illustrates how vicious life can be at giving you information.

There is also this tendency to not use Ockham’s razor. Despite having very simple explanations that check all the boxes, people often feel like a complicated explanation is better.
